class.name: ResourceFormatLoaderMIDI
class.brief_description: Loads Standard MIDI Files as [AudioStreamMIDI] resources.
class.description: The [ResourceFormatLoader] that lets Standard MIDI Files be loaded directly as [AudioStream] resources. It's registered automatically by this extension and recognizes the [code].mid[/code], [code].midi[/code], [code].rmi[/code], [code].xmi[/code], and [code].kar[/code] extensions, reading the file's bytes into a new [AudioStreamMIDI]. You won't normally use this class directly; it's what makes [code]load("res://song.mid")[/code] work.
